title: Bring up Comovo task and memory sync between Windows and the Mac through the engram-data branch
outcome: Bring up Comovo task and memory sync between Windows and the Mac through the engram-data branch
acceptance: The Mac runs an Engram build from current master with its own initialized store for the Comovo project, built and installed inside the agreed locations
Comovo's tasks and memories are exported on Windows into an engram-data branch pushed to the private aolowko/fit_friends origin, after a check that the export carries no secret or credential
The Mac imports that branch and shows the same Comovo tasks and memories
One further change made on each host reaches the other host through a repeat export and import with memories

completion.summary: Completed the Windows–Mac Comovo task and memory rollout on 2026-11-17. The Mac installed the agreed Engram build and initialized its own ready store. Windows exported and published the private data branch after the disclosure check, and the Mac imported 234 tasks and 3 memories. Both directions were demonstrated with memory revisions and a task created on the Mac and completed on Windows. Fresh independent evaluation dfd481472856414fab33b192b5b554cf passed all four criteria.
